judgment.promotion_candidate_answer: NO. Regime-capped graded AddOn does not yet clear promotion-candidate validation.
judgment.extension_line_decision: Yes. AddOn grading should keep moving toward an exposure-engine style extension line.
judgment.answer_1: Core+RegimeCappedAddOn[cap_soft] does not outperform the binary AddOn baseline strongly enough on the full validation set.
judgment.answer_2: OOS stability is not preserved: strict win ratio 0.33, avg dReturn +4.35pp, avg dSharpe +0.019, avg dCalmar +0.123.
judgment.answer_3: The regime cap does not fully remove MaxDD degradation; best full-sample dMaxDD is -1.24pp.
judgment.answer_4: No. This structure still cannot be considered a promotion candidate.
judgment.answer_5: Yes. AddOn grading should move toward an exposure-engine design, but only through narrow modulation layers like this one, not by opening new strategy families.
